transparency.intended_use: Prioritization and suspicious region localization on standard posteroanterior (PA) and anteroposterior (AP) adult chest radiographs.
contraindications: Severe rotation or obscuring surgical hardware over bilateral lung fields
transparency.training_cohort_description: Trained on de-identified NIH ChestX-ray14 cohort filtered for adult PA/AP views with multi-reader consensus.
known_limitations: Elderly patients (>65 yrs) with baseline hyperinflation, kyphosis, or chronic interstitial markings show reduced specificity (-0.04).
AP portable supine projections overestimate cardiac silhouette size compared to erect PA films; cardiomegaly flags on portable films require careful clinician magnification adjustment.
Sub-centimeter apical pneumothoraces can be missed in poorly inspired exposures.

transparency.intended_use: Assistive triaging and risk stratification of ambulatory adult patients presenting with suspected ischemic cardiac symptoms.
contraindications: Patients with existing ventricular assist devices (LVAD)
transparency.training_cohort_description: Derived from the UCI Heart Disease benchmark (Cleveland, Hungary, Switzerland, Long Beach V.A.) merged with de-identified ambulatory lab cohorts.
known_limitations: Under-samples female presentations: atypical angina symptoms (dyspnea, nausea without chest pressure) exhibit higher false-negative rates (sensitivity delta -0.07).
Serum cholesterol values are unfasted in ~14% of retrospective intake notes.
Requires clinician verification of baseline medications (e.g. beta-blockers) which artificially blunt max achieved heart rate.
